desc: Daniel Defense pioneered 3D-printed suppressors with the DD Wave. Now they apply that innovation to go further. Meet the Null9Ti. Designed for PCCs, the Null9Ti's high-low architecture minimizes blowback while reducing toxic gases and particulate for a cleaner, more controlled shooting experience. Over 75% quieter than a bare muzzle, quieter than leading 9mm suppressors on the market. Its weldless, fully 3D-printed titanium design delivers strength, consistency, and durability-at just 4.4 ounces. With Mini-HUB compatibility, it integrates seamlessly into your existing setup. The Null9Ti. Embrace the sound of silence.
